Class Empty

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytrucker.model.componentClasses.Component
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytrucker.model.componentClasses.Empty
public class Empty extends Component
This class represents an empty position on a ship board. It is used to indicate free positions where no component is placed.
